subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should browser snapshot become viewport-scoped after scroll, or should OpenClaw add a separate visible-viewport read while preserving the current full/tree snapshot contract?
rationale: The current docs and implementation do not promise viewport-scoped snapshots, and changing the default could affect workflows that rely on full-page/tree reads.

options.title: Add visible mode and metadata
options.body: Add an explicit visible-viewport snapshot mode with scroll/viewport metadata while keeping full/tree reads available for compatibility.

options.title: Change snapshot default
options.body: Make the existing snapshot action viewport-scoped by default and document a full/raw escape hatch for callers that need whole-page reads.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Keep snapshot as a full/tree read and document that callers must use screenshots or a future tool for viewport-visible content.

recommendation.title: Add visible mode and metadata
recommendation.body: Add an explicit visible-viewport snapshot mode with scroll/viewport metadata while keeping full/tree reads available for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the browser plugin's model-facing contract and docs, and history points to this person for browser plugin ownership and product-surface work.
